description: Complete Buyer (retailer) features in users-frontend: search with filters (brand, RAM, storage, color), cart + prepaid checkout, order list with filters, order detail with delivery tracking timeline and cancel button. CRITICAL: enforce supplier anonymity — display only 'SELL BY SELL verified stock' label, never render supplierId or supplierId.shopName. Backend already sanitizes responses for buyer role; frontend must never render any supplier identity field.

findings:
Successfully implemented all FEAT-002 requirements:
1. BuyerSearch: Added filter dropdowns (brand, RAM, storage, color) with client-side filtering of skus array. Confirmed listingLabel displays 'SELL BY SELL verified stock' - no supplier names rendered.
2. Cart functionality: Replaced direct buy() with addToCart(), added cart badge showing item count, implemented checkout flow with POST /orders + POST /orders/:id/confirm, added loading spinner and error handling, navigates to order detail on success.
3. BuyerOrders: Added status filter dropdown with all statuses (reserved, awaiting_admin, assigned, picked, delivered, disputed, cancelled), implemented client-side filtering, confirmed listingLabel column shows verified stock label only.
4. BuyerOrder: Added events timeline with vertical CSS styling (left border + dots), prominently displays deliveryOtp, added Cancel button for reserved/awaiting_admin orders with reason input, implemented ETA countdown for assigned/picked orders showing remaining minutes, confirmed 'Supplier public identity hidden' message displayed.

Privacy verification: grep 'supplierId' in Buyer.jsx returned zero matches in rendered JSX elements. Build verification: npm run build exited with code 0, dist/ created successfully.
